description: Render Markdown to a sanitised HTML page or fragment, or to a PDF, with tables, fenced code, heading anchors, an optional table of contents and a choice of themes. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: a file (text/html | application/pdf) returned inline, at most 1 MiB. document.html / fragment.html (text/html; charset=utf-8) or document.pdf. meta: {format, theme, title, headings, bytes, pages?}. pdf costs 3 credits, html and fragment 1.

format.description: html = complete page (1 credit), fragment = content only (1 credit), pdf = A4 document (3 credits)

markdown.description: The Markdown source (up to 1 MB of text)

theme.description: Built-in stylesheet for html and pdf

title.description: Page title; default is the first level-1 heading

toc.description: Add a table of contents above the content

name: markdown_render
title: Markdown renderer
